svg.title: Prompt-Enhanced Multi-Expert Fine-Tuning and Multi-Expert Advantage RL Pipeline
svg.desc: Full figure inventory: left Input panel contains two expert prompt cards, an instruction card, an images dashed sample frame with mechanical sketches, and arrows entering Base Model and Policy Model. Top-right section I contains Base Model, output documents O1/On/ON, L_MEF loss, CoT answer code-card, and expert icons. Bottom-right section II contains Policy Model, three expert output groups, reward model, estimation advantage expert-internal block, GT model object, three expert relative advantage groups, KL E+/E- box, L_grpo box, and hard-example cylinder. The layout is divided by a vertical dashed separator and a horizontal dashed separator; arrows are orthogonal where shown.

g.desc: Input panel origin is the title at top center; prompt cards and instruction/images are vertically aligned beneath it with arrow conduits to the model column.
Images sample contains a left dimensioned profile and a right orthographic line drawing, matching the miniature CAD-style views.
Section I starts with Base Model at left, conducts rightward to sampled output documents, then L_MEF, CoT answer, and expert icons; symmetry is a horizontal processing chain.

Section II originates at Policy Model and conducts rightward to three output groups, centrally through reward and estimation advantage, then to three relative advantage groups and three loss/example targets. The output and advantage groups use vertical equipartition.
